title: VVER-440 Reactor Architecture, Baseline Power and 20-Year Life Extensions

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Built between 1974 and 1987, the four VVER-440/213 pressurized water reactor units at Paks produce roughly half of Hungary's domestic electricity. In the 2000s a 20-year lifetime extension was approved for the units (to 2032–2037), and in December 2022 the National Assembly approved preparations for a further 20-year extension.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Technical reports often use *révén* ('by means of'; you know it from earlier units) with a verbal noun: `A hatósági vizsgálatok révén ellenőrizhető, hogy a blokkok megfelelnek-e a biztonsági előírásoknak`.
